title: Filipino-Style Stew with Peanuts
description: A hearty and flavorful stew from the Philippines, featuring peanuts for added crunch.

ingredients.name: stew vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, potatoes, and green beans

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped peanuts and cook until lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the seitan and cook until it's lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew vegetables, soy sauce, fish sauce, and coconut milk (if using). Stir to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the stew is heated through and the flavors have melded together, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped peanuts and a sprinkle of black pepper, if desired.
